app.name: License Consumption Explorer
app.description: Which hosts, namespaces and apps consume DPS licence

scopes.name: storage:system:read
scopes.comment: read billing usage events from dt.system.events

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: resolve host, Kubernetes, application, monitor and service names with bulk lookups. Without it rows show bare entity IDs

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: resolve host, Kubernetes and application names on environments that have Smartscape instead of the classic entity tables

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:read
scopes.comment: read your own saved settings: rate-card overrides, commitment, allowances, ownership rules, team budgets and, if connected, the Account Management connection

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:write
scopes.comment: save those settings for your user only, only when you choose Save. Includes the Account Management client ID and secret if you save a connection
